name: Smoke: ZPL label printer
description: The release check for a ZPL label printer. Run it on every channel the printer offers: its spooler or CUPS queue, IPP, and the raw socket. Three labels a channel at most; one job must fail and print nothing.

jobs.description: two labels in one job: the queue window or lpstat -o shows one job, whose id is the returned job id. Over IPP the log names the format negotiated for ZPL
no label: a named converter on a printer language cannot run, so the job fails before anything is sent. On the raw socket this is also a converter named on a channel that renders nothing

one label: the 4 by 6 inch PDF on media of its own size, with hard bars; scan the barcode. A channel with a driver or a raster format prints it; one that reads neither, usually the raw socket, fails before anything is sent and names what it reads
